        w = idf[j]
        s = 0.0
        for i in range(n):
            s += matrix[i][j] * w * v_scaled[i]
        u[j] = s
    result = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(n):
        row = matrix[i]
        s = 0.0
        for j in range(m):
            s += row[j] * idf[j] * u[j]
        result[i] = s * inv_sqrt[i]
    return {'degree': degree, 'result': result}"}
